scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,yellow "corepack pnpm --filter @milezero/backend dev" "corepack pnpm --filter @milezero/frontend dev"
scripts.dev:demo: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,yellow "corepack pnpm --filter @milezero/backend dev:demo" "corepack pnpm --filter @milezero/frontend dev"
scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter @milezero/frontend build && corepack pnpm --filter @milezero/backend build
scripts.test: corepack pnpm --filter @milezero/backend test && corepack pnpm --filter @milezero/frontend test
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @milezero/backend typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @milezero/frontend typecheck
